content: संधृ €10 <ab>U.</ab> ²1 To hold, bear, carry. .²2 To hold up, support, prop, sustain; अरैः संधार्यते नाभिः <ls>Pt. 1. 81</ls>. .²3 To curb, restrain, check. .²4 To keep in mind, retain in memory; यः सततं परिपृच्छति शृणोति संधारयत्यनिशम् <ls>Pt. 5. 92</ls>. .²5 To hold, have, possess; retain, keep; भृत्यः न स संधार्यो भूभुजा भूतिमिच्छता <ls>Pt. 1. 112</ls>. .²6 To observe, follow. .²7 To bear, suffer, endure. .²8 To survive, remain alive.
